result.summary: Review of TASK-0161 (Planisphere Knowledge Tree, 1920x1080 at 100% in color and grayscale across zoom steps 1, 2, 3, and 5). Strengths: sector hatching works well as a grayscale secondary channel (A5), the disabled 'Отдать приказ: фокус' button displays an explicit inline reason (C4), 'Цель' and 'Фокус освоения' are explained inline (C6), 'Закрыть x (Esc)' is clearly visible (C8), the scrollable node card has a high-contrast >= 8 px scrollbar with a clipped bottom continuation cue (A12), and node icons/glyphs are crisp at Шаг 5. However, multiple blocking (§12 ⛔) defects are visible at 100% scale: overview nodes at Шаг 1 are < 16x16 px with unreadable inner glyphs (A2); unbacked HUD/map texts ('Узлов: 99 · открыто 51', 'Шаг 2/3 из 6', and Шаг 5 year labels) are crossed by map hatching, edges, and nodes (C5) with low-contrast pale gray year digits and top-bar chip labels (A3) and pale 'неизвестен' outlines/edges over busy hatching (A4); 'Шаг 2 из 6' collides directly with 'Металлы 10/15' (A9); the top-bar 4-bar speed gauge lacks a numeric value and unit (C3); 'кольцо' has contradictory meanings between card ('кольцо 3') and legend ('кольцо = 10 лет') while the circular 'выбран' ring masks the node's hexagon at Шаг 2-3 (C2); top-bar chips lack 5-second clarity (C1); 'фронтир' and abbreviations ('ТРД', 'ТРДД', 'NiCr') are unexplained (C6); and no keyboard focus frame is shown (A7). Note: dynamic/settings criteria (A6 keyboard traversal, A8 reduced motion, A9 125%/150% scale, A11 colorblindness simulation, C7 settings fallback) cannot be verified from static 100% screenshots alone.
